title: John Frieda, Hair-Care Mogul Who Soothed Women’s Curls, Has Died
summary_full: He was a celebrity stylist to rock stars and royalty whose blockbuster product, Frizz Ease, changed his fortunes (and women’s hair) forever. He was 75.
